BRANCHID='1313' (UPDATED) .
BRANCHID='1440' (DELETED) . 
BRANCHID='1132' (UNCHANGED) .
BRANCHID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select BRANCHID BRANCHID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT BRANCHID BRANCHID2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_BRANCHCODES WHERE BRANCHID='1313'
UNION ALL
SELECT BRANCHID BRANCHID2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_BRANCHCODES WHERE BRANCHID='1440'
UNION ALL
SELECT BRANCHID BRANCHID2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_BRANCHCODES WHERE BRANCHID='1132'
UNION ALL
SELECT BRANCHID BRANCHID2, * FROM
EDS.CCD_BRANCHCODES WHERE BRANCHID='9999' ) temp order by BRANCHID, SCD_START_DATE
